name: Hume Inhe Rokna Hoga Tokna Hoga - Narendra Modi
visual_description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressing the nation with open hand gestures, the Indian flag behind him, and the subtitle 'Hume inhe rokna hoga, tokna hoga'.
usage_context: Used to express the urgent need to stop or call out someone doing an annoying, cringe, or unacceptable habit or behavior.

example.caption: When relatives start asking about your marriage plans at family gatherings

text_areas.description: Situation or behavior that must be stopped
